expr: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));for(let i=0;i<50&&!document.documentElement.dataset.ready;i++)await w(100);const t=document.getElementById('tour');const top=t.getBoundingClientRect().top+scrollY;scrollTo(0,top);await w(1500);const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('.w-panel')];return '面板='+p.length+' 圓點='+document.querySelectorAll('.w-dots button').length+' 第1張透明度='+p[0].style.opacity+' 圖已載='+document.querySelectorAll('.w-panel img[src]').length})()

(async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const t=document.getElementById('tour');const top=t.getBoundingClientRect().top+scrollY;const span=t.offsetHeight-innerHeight;scrollTo(0,top+span*(2.5/7));await w(1500);const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('.w-panel')];return '捲到 2.5 張：透明度='+p.map(x=>(+x.style.opacity).toFixed(2)).join(',')+' 圖已載='+document.querySelectorAll('.w-panel img[src]').length})()

(async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const t=document.getElementById('tour');const top=t.getBoundingClientRect().top+scrollY;const span=t.offsetHeight-innerHeight;scrollTo(0,top+span);await w(1500);const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('.w-panel')];return '捲到最後：最後一張透明度='+p[7].style.opacity+' 標題='+p[7].querySelector('h2').textContent})()
